instruction: Implement only the requirement in the fixed standalone browser page. Replace its single /* MODEL_BEHAVIOR */ marker with vanilla JavaScript; keep every other byte unchanged. Register app.onView with one callback for opening the detail page. app.document() returns {id, title, tags}; app.requestSuggestions(id) records a request and renders the available suggestions for that document. The fixed page already renders the title, document ID, Suggest button, and empty suggestion area. Return only the complete HTML page.

arms.A: Suggestions are shown on the document detail page and can be accepted or rejected. Suggestions are requested automatically when you open a document that still has an inbox tag.
arms.B: On a document detail page, show suggestions that the user can accept or reject. Opening an inbox-tagged document automatically requests its suggestions.
arms.C: Suggestions are shown on the document detail page and can be accepted or rejected.
